original_question: Which properties of the velocity field are sufficient to guarantee the existence of a unique global smooth solution of the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations for all times, assuming the initial conditions are already smooth? This asks for structural conditions on the evolving velocity field that rule out singularity formation and ensure global regularity.
